about: Acceptance test for semantic search (relic4-scan, 2026-10-23, from Nat: 'find the wordcloud image and map that I posted to Facebook'). Queries avoid the words wordcloud / word cloud / semantic map. Ground truth = the sessions relic4-scan found with the keyword 'wordcloud|word cloud|semantic map' (23 text rows). A query passes when ANY of its sessions appears in the top 10; recall@10 = passed / queries.

queries.q: picture of words sized by how often I said them
scatter of my prompts by meaning
the charts I shared on Facebook about my sessions
image of my most used words for a facebook post
plot every message as a dot grouped by topic
who made the three charts in my screenshots
